title: Read and match
text: It is morning. Bobby is with his dad. Sam is with his mum. What can they say?
Can you think of a different animal family to replace Tad and his mum in pictures 4 and 5? Draw them and tell your story to the class.
1 Read the story again and find the letters “Oo”, “Pp” and “Qq”.
2 Listen, point and say the letters.
O o     P p     Q q
